kjv: on the second sabbath after the first
note: TR "en sabbato deuteroproto" (a puzzling word found nowhere else, probably from a marginal note) against "en sabbato" in P4, P75, Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, L, W.

kjv: for it was founded upon a rock
mine: because it had been well built
note: TR "tethemeliōto gar epi ten petran" (from Matt 7:25) against "dia to kalos oikodomesthai auten" in P75, Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, L, W.
meden apelpizontes may mean "expecting nothing back" or (as in later Greek) "despairing of no one"; both versions take the first sense.
